integrity.claim_scope: The infinite statement is proved symbolically; exhaustive computation for \(3\le n\le9\) is a cross-check rather than the proof.
integrity.literature_scope: Originality is assessed against the named sources, aliases, and retrieved comparisons; failed searches are not treated as proof of novelty.

scientific_limitations: The result concerns ordinary zero forcing on connected crown graphs only.
The boundary graph \(\operatorname{Cr}_3\cong C_6\) is already covered by the published cycle polynomial and is not claimed independently.

The original full text of the 2013 Mays item on bipartite zero forcing was not accessible; a later source attributes to it the complete-bipartite scalar formula. This is retained as an access-related originality risk.
title: All zero forcing sets of crown graphs
